open_points.subject: RECORDS BUILT FOR THIS MODULE and frozen-model construction instruction
open_points.text:
Constructing such a record here — its constructor, model_construct, model_validate,
or model_copy of a parameter of that type — is rejected (record_construction_bypassed).
open_points.other_text: Never assign to an attribute of a model value (models are frozen): derive a changed value with value.model_copy(update={...}) or construct a new instance.
open_points.question: Which rule governs the records listed in RECORDS BUILT FOR THIS MODULE: must they be changed only through the imported builders, or may this module use model_copy or direct construction?

open_points.subject: _authorize_document_reference dependency note
open_points.text: - _authorize_document_reference: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST open exactly one transaction, read the document and its owning aggregate only through the expenses repository PortalTransaction.expenses returns, and close that read transaction by exactly one PortalTransaction.rollback immediately after the last read, marking it closed before it evaluates project scope or client visibility and before it raises BinaryAccessRejected; leaving the transaction open on any path, committing it, and using a legacy PortalTransaction expense method are forbidden.
open_points.rule:
Нота остаётся требованием к
поведению: выражения, вызовы методов, точечная навигация и строковый
микро-синтаксис в ней запрещены.
open_points.question: Replace the dotted method reference PortalTransaction.rollback with classified prose that requires rolling back the transaction without using dotted navigation in the note body.
